title: 25th Sitting of first Session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/25/1/2025).

Written question from Hithadhoo Central MP Ahmed Azaan Marzooq to the Minister of Higher Education, Labour and Skills Development, Dr Ali Haidar Ahmed: students and parents complain that the ministry is slow to answer students' emails and letters; why the delay, and what steps have been and are being taken to fix it?

Written question from Hithadhoo Central MP Ahmed Azaan Marzooq to the Minister of Higher Education, Labour and Skills Development, Dr Ali Haidar Ahmed: students on student loans and scholarships complain of delays in receiving stipends and in tuition fees being paid; why the delays, and what has been done to remove the cause?

From the Speaker's desk: the President's nominee for Deputy Governor of the Maldives Monetary Authority, under Article 6(3) of the MMA Act (Law No. 6/81), is sent to the relevant standing committee for review.
Preliminary debate on a government bill, sponsored by Kinbidhoo MP Ali Ashraq, to amend the Tobacco Control Act (Law No. 15/2010).
Unfinished business: continued debate on the Housing Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Maafannu Central MP Asma Rasheed.

Unfinished business: continued debate on the resolution by Galolhu South MP Meekail Ahmed Naseem to gauge members' views on the Chair acting in ways that obstruct the Majlis's work, contrary to the Constitution and the Standing Orders.
Report of the Independent Institutions Committee on the President's nominee for Vice President of the Civil Service Commission, under Article 17(c) of the Civil Service Act (Law No. 5/2007).
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting took two written questions on higher education delays, sent the MMA Deputy Governor nominee to committee, opened debate on a Tobacco Control Act amendment, continued the Housing Bill and the resolution on the Chair's conduct, and took up a report on the Civil Service Commission vice president nominee.
